title: Paid time off (PTO)
text: Full-time employees earn 15 days of paid time off per year. Unused days roll over up to 5 days.

title: Sick leave
text: Employees get 10 days of sick leave per year. A doctor's note is needed after 3 days in a row.

title: Parental leave
text: New parents get 12 weeks of paid parental leave.

title: Remote work
text: Employees may work remotely up to 3 days per week with manager approval.

title: Health insurance
text: Coverage starts on the first day of the month after the start date.

title: Dental claims
text: Dental claims must be filed within 90 days of the visit.

title: Travel reimbursement
text: Submit travel expenses within 30 days with receipts. Meals are reimbursed up to $75 per day.

title: Claim appeals
text: If a claim is denied, you can appeal within 60 days.
